references.text: Both verses document the tactical success achieved by the Benjamites in the early stages of the battle, setting the stage for the later total judgment.
Creates a theological contrast between the temporary success of the sinful tribe and their final divine judgment.
Complementary numbers that together illustrate the total destruction and mutual annihilation in the civil war.
Creates a narrative contrast between the Benjamites' first tactical victory and their subsequent total encirclement and defeat.
Links the cause (refusal of justice) directly to the consequence (the massive violence and defeat).
